decision.observation: Jump landed Hornet back on the mossy ledge; the upper stone-brick arc bands remain unreachable by jumping alone. The two new crescent icons in the HUD appeared right after the giant shell burst into light and flowered — possibly a new ability or resource.
decision.hypothesis: The shell event may have upgraded the Harpoon (S) into a grappling hook, or granted a new movement resource shown by the crescent icons. Test S aiming upward at the hanging vines/ceiling.
decision.memory: Shell burst granted two crescent HUD icons (6→8 masks).
